|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns the position of the original (loaded) center of an object in model coordinates. Despite its name, it has nothing to do with [[boundingBox]] or [[boundingBoxReal]], it returns offset where {{hl|[0, 0, 0]}} was [[Object Builder]] / [[Oxygen 2]] when model was created.

|s1= [[boundingCenter]] object

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Position#PositionRelative|PositionRelative]]

|x1= <sqf>_center = boundingCenter TruckOne;</sqf>

|seealso= [[boundingBox]] [[sizeOf]] [[boundingBoxReal]] [[getPosWorld]] [[setPosWorld]] [[aimPos]]
}}
